test_overview: Evaluated admin photo and review management for the venue app (port 8000). Steps 1-6 passed fully: admin login and venue creation ("Photo Review Test Cafe", /admin/establishments/23/edit); photo upload with 'Photos (1/20)' header, Primary badge on first upload, and 'Food & Drinks' default category; category change to 'Interior' that persisted across a refresh, plus second upload keeping exactly one Primary; 'Make Primary' moved the Primary badge to the second photo and deleting it promoted the earliest remaining photo to Primary; review minimum-length validation blocked 'Hi #tag' (6/10 chars excluding '#', Add Review disabled) leaving review count at 0; adding 'Great #coffee and #cozy atmosphere. Very #kid-friendly!' produced Reviews (1) in admin and, in a separate visitor context reached via Home -> Cafes -> venue card, a 'What people say' section displaying lowercase '#' badges #coffee, #cozy, #kid-friendly. Step 7 FAILED FATALLY: the test plan requires editing an existing review, but the admin review UI offers only Add and Delete - each review card shows only a Delete button, with no inline edit, modal, or separate edit screen (confirmed in ReviewManager.jsx, and server.js has no PUT /reviews endpoint). Since the action could not be performed and is FATAL by default, the step scored 0 and per the test plan rules the remaining steps were not executed. Final score: 42/58.

steps.description: test_admin_login_and_create_test_venue - Passed. Logged in at /admin/login as admin/admin123, clicked 'Add Establishment' from the dashboard, created 'Photo Review Test Cafe' (Cafes, 500 Test Blvd, Pittsburgh, PA 15222, lat 40.45, lng -79.99, $$, Open). Submit redirected to /admin/establishments/23/edit; heading 'Edit Photo Review Test Cafe', Photos section 'Photos (0/20)' and Reviews section 'Reviews (0)' both visible.

test_photo_upload_and_primary_default - Passed. Header indicated max 20 photos (non-fatal check). Uploaded /test_assets/test_photo_1.jpg; header updated to 'Photos (1/20)' (fatal check), the uploaded photo showed a Primary badge (non-fatal check), and the photo category defaulted to 'Food & Drinks' (non-fatal check).

test_photo_category_change_and_second_upload - Passed. Changed photo 95's category to 'Interior'. Waited and confirmed UI kept 'Interior', and refreshed the edit page (explicitly allowed by the plan) - still 'Interior'. Uploaded test_photo_2.png (photo 96); header 'Photos (2/20)' and exactly one Primary badge among the two photos (on photo 95, the first upload).

test_change_primary_and_delete_primary_promotes_earliest - Passed. Clicked 'Make Primary' on photo 96; Primary badge moved to 96 and was removed from 95 (exactly one badge). Deleted photo 96 via its Delete button, confirmed the modal; only photo 95 remains ('Photos (1/20)') and 95 is Primary again - earliest uploaded photo promoted.

test_review_minimum_length_and_character_counting - Passed. Empty state 'No reviews yet' visible (non-fatal check). Entered 'Hi #tag'; counter showed '6/10 characters minimum (excluding #)' confirming '#' exclusion. Add Review button remained disabled; an attempted (forced) click did not add the review - 'Reviews (0)' and zero review cards after the attempt. No recovery needed.

test_add_review_with_hashtags_shows_keywords_to_visitor - Passed. In context_A added 'Great #coffee and #cozy atmosphere. Very #kid-friendly!': Reviews header 'Reviews (1)' and the full text appeared in the review list. In context_B (visitor, not logged in) navigated Home -> Cafes category -> 'Photo Review Test Cafe' card -> venue detail /venue/23. 'What people say' section visible with exactly the badges #coffee, #cozy, #kid-friendly; all lowercase with a leading '#'.

test_edit_review_updates_keywords - FAILED (FATAL). The admin review UI provides no way to edit an existing review: the review card renders only the text and a 'Delete' button (no Edit button/link), ReviewManager.jsx implements only add/delete (no inline edit, modal, or edit screen), and server.js has no PUT /reviews endpoint. The required action 'edit the existing review and replace it with the new text' cannot be performed, so the step failed; as the failure is fatal, its verifications (keywords update in context_B) were not applicable.
test_delete_review_hides_keywords_section - NOT EXECUTED. The fatal action failure in Step 7 requires the whole test plan to stop; future steps must not be performed. 0 points.
test_cleanup - NOT EXECUTED. The fatal action failure in Step 7 requires the whole test plan to stop; future steps must not be performed. 0 points.
